title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, University Of California on 1981-09-13
lineage: 1st generation cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear early‑80s soundboard capture revives this legendary show with impressive clarity despite minor buzz.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the new SBD source as a massive sonic upgrade, noting exceptional clarity that makes the performance shine. A few occasional buzzes are mentioned but are considered part of the day's character, and no specific musical issues are cited, indicating an overall positive listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review highlights a major improvement in recording clarity and calls the show awesome; minor buzzes keep it from perfect, yielding a high but not flawless rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clarity is dramatically improved; occasional buzz present but attributed to the original event rather than the transfer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer’s enthusiasm suggests a generally strong performance.
